regime.summary: Policy rate 13.75% after a 150bp hike, 6M T-bill 1.05pp above it so the market prices more hikes, CPI rising, rupee down 12.2% in 3 months, KSE100 down 11.4% over 12 months. This resembles the 2017-19 balance-of-payments hike squeeze, where the lesson was to read the rate and the rupee. Stay mostly in cash.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 13.75%; last MPC decision 2022-05-23: hike (+150bp)
6M T-bill minus policy rate +1.05pp (market pricing hikes); CPI rising over 3 months (+1.5pp)
Balance-of-payments squeeze and hike cycle: the index fell 46% to the August 2019 low and 3 of 75 liquid names rose. Lesson: read the rate and the rupee, not the politics.

core.thesis: Small defensive position only. Fertilizer is the one sector with positive 6m return, EFERT trades at a P/E of 4.8 with a 21.7% dividend yield and sits within 10% of its 252-day high. Low P/E is only weak evidence (not confirmed, n=42), so size is small.
